newsitem.title: DUBAI: UAE police look into alleged investment fraud.
newsitem.headline: UAE police look into alleged investment fraud.

text.p: United Arab Emirates police are investigating fraud charges against a brokerage firm alleged to have swindled local investors of $36 million, newspapers reported on Friday.
The name of the firm, which the newspapers said was licensed by the UAE central bank, was not disclosed for legal reasons.

"Investors claim that a brokerage firm run by three men swindled them out of their cash by pretending to invest in the Hong Kong stock market when they were keeping the money for their own use," the newspapers said.
They said authorities had established that claims by the firm to have links with the Hong Kong bourse proved to be false.
Two owners of the Sharjah-based firm were being investigated and the third owner had escaped to India, the newspapers added.
